title: Burlap Fall Banner
text: Burlap Fall Banner. The perfect completion to a homey, fun Fall decor.  I draped mine below our mantel.  (We have an electric insert and the banner is a good 6 ft above the insert - no chance of touching or flames) Really cute and surprisingly sturdy.  I feel confident if carefully stored, it could be used over several years.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Whaline Happy Fall Pumpkin Burlap Banner Harvest Home Decor Bunting Flag Garland Party Thanksgiving Day Decoration
features: Special design  – There is a pumpkin sign in the banner, which is unique and necessary for you to decorate your house or family party
Meaningful and allegorical  – Our banner is printed with words, HAPPY FALL, which expresses the joyfulness and appreciation on Thanksgiving Day

Perfect decoration  – You can use it to decorate any event you want, especially for Thanksgiving Day decoration and parties indoor or outdoor. What’s more, it can beautify your dining room, store, office and more
Natural material  – The banner is made of natural burlap, durable and free from smell. In addition, it is not evident when it is dirty and it is not easy to be broken, too
Measurement  – The length of the cord is 2 meters in total and the size (l x w) of each banner is 13 x 17.5 cm, whose size is fit for most situations
